cohort: Mothers who delivered in Sweden between 1973 and 2012.
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a small increased risk of suicide attempts during the first postpartum year compared to vaginal delivery, but not with an increased risk of death by suicide.
mod_finding: Compared to vaginal delivery, Cesarean delivery was associated with a small increased risk of suicide attempts during the first postpartum year, but not with an increased risk of death by suicide.
